text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock as part of my whole portfolio, not as a separate account anchored to its purchase price.","Selling winners felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain; decisions should reflect my goals and the stock’s prospects.","Losses may feel painful, but avoiding that feeling is not a reason to hold; with random price changes and infrequent reviews, I should use consistent rules rather than react to short-term moves."]}
